title: Security Cooperation (SC) Planner (I) (LtCol to 2ndLt) FMOS, DC PP&O
raw_text:
11. MOS 0560, Security Cooperation (SC) Planner (I) (LtCol to 2ndLt) FMOS,
DC PP&O

    a. Summary. SC Planners work closely with operational planners to
ensure planned SC engagements enable USMC operations, to include readiness
generation and/or sustainment activities for USMC forces, potential
prepositioning and access, coalition partner interoperability, and
contribution to deterrence via the development of partner nation defensive
capabilities. SC Planners develop multi-year engagement plans in support of
overarching global campaign plans, combatant command campaign plans, and
other high-level strategic guidance. SC Planners have a comprehensive
understanding of the USMC SC planning and execution cycle.

       b.   Prerequisites

            (1) Security requirement:   secret clearance required.

        (2) Complete the Foundations of Security Cooperation (SC-102) and
Introduction to Socium (SOC-101) virtual training courses provided by the
Defense Security Cooperation University (DSCU).

       c.   Requirements

        (1) Complete the Security Cooperation Planners Course (SCPC) (N030JX3
or N030JXM) provided by the Security Cooperation Training Detachment, Marine
Corps Intelligence Schools.

        (2) MOS 0560 will be assigned by the Marine's O-5 level or above
commanding officer upon completion of Security Cooperation Planners Course.

    d. Duties. Plan, coordinate, assess, monitor, and evaluate SC
engagement plans, regional plans, and/or exercise plans. SC planners provide
subject matter expertise on SC authorities, activities, and joint,
interagency, intergovernmental, and multinational integration with SC.

    e.      Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
None.

       f.   Related Military Skill

            (1) Operational Planner, 0505.

            (2)   Advanced Information Operations Planner, 0550.

            (3) Advisor, 0570.

            (4) Operational Advisor, 0571.



                                            1-38                      Enclosure (1)
 1108                                                                NAVMC 1200.1L



            (5) Civil Military Operations Planner, 1708.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
